name: scaleRoots_ne_zero
statement: R[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) (s : R) : scaleRoots p s ≠ 0

name: support_scaleRoots_eq
statement: R[X]) {s : R} (hs : s ∈ nonZeroDivisors R) : (scaleRoots p s).support = p.support

name: degree_scaleRoots
statement: R[X]) {s : R} : degree (scaleRoots p s) = degree p

name: rootMultiplicity_scaleRoots
statement: R[X]) {r a : R} (hr : IsLeftRegular r) : rootMultiplicity (r * a) (p.scaleRoots r) = rootMultiplicity a p

name: roots_scaleRoots
statement: R[X]) {r : R} (hr : IsUnit r) : (p.scaleRoots r).roots = p.roots.map (r * ·)
